title: Palcheck §8 routed leg (d)+(e) indexes crisis rows without the testing_lvl_ok premise guard its sibling legs all carry
detail: On premise failure (pipe_slot or live-bundle search fails) legs (a)/(b)/(c)/(f)/(g) skip via `if testing_lvl_ok`, but (d)+(e) unconditionally indexes pipe_congestion[ps8] — empty/short slice panics, killing palcheck before later sections and the summary.
recommended_fix: Wrap the (d)+(e) block in the same `if testing_lvl_ok {` guard legs (a)-(g) use.

title: §8 pins absolute peak/trough ticks assuming the live bundle index ≡ 0 (mod 16); a packing change lands the fixture on the wrong PULSE16 phase
evidence:
bi8: u32 = 0
found_bi := false
for b in 0..<len(state.bundles.bundle_count) {
	if state.bundles.bundle_count[b] > 0 {
		bi8 = u32(b)
		found_bi = true
		break
	}
}
...
peak_tick: u64 = 1000 // % 16 == 8
trough_tick: u64 = 992 // % 16 == 0
--- app/render/view.odin:935 ---
idx := (tick + u64(node_id) * 5) * u64(advance) & 15
detail: Phase is (tick + bi8*5) & 15; ticks 1000/992 hit table indices 8/0 only when bi8 ≡ 0 mod 16. bi8 = 8 swaps peak and trough; other indices shift phase — peak-prediction legs (a)/(b)/(f)/(g) fail spuriously despite the fixture's own packing-change defense.
recommended_fix: Derive the pinned ticks from the discovered bi8: pick ticks t with (t + bi8*5) & 15 == 8 (peak) and == 0 (trough) instead of absolute 1000/992.

title: Duplicate `snapshot` tokens silently accepted by the new motion-strip arg walk
detail: Duplicate zoom= is a usage error, but `snapshot snapshot` (7 tokens) sets the flag twice and is silently accepted; the pre-change parser usage-errored on any 7-token call, so the stated typo-is-usage-error contract has this one hole.
recommended_fix: Track a seen-snapshot bool and usage() on a second `snapshot` token, mirroring the zoom= duplicate guard.
